derivation: from a presumed derivative of G142 (αἴρω);
def: to prepare, i.e. spice (with stimulating condiments)

occurrences.text: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
